status: review only; no asset removed or optimized
hybrid: Rooms/walls/circulation use a floor plan. Furniture/decor may use top, front or 2.5D as appropriate.
sizeCaveats: Measured gzip is an in-memory estimate, not an applied asset transformation.
One gzip bundle is a text-compression benchmark, not a working runtime package.
Conditional removals assume every merge candidate can be represented as a preset. This is not verified; actual saving will be smaller after adding presets/decor.
No approved map HTML or asset changed. Gallery already embeds gzip data.
